subject: is it possible to model speed using mirt package

messages.author: 40fc57d53124bd8d
messages.subject: is it possible to model speed using mirt package
parts:
Hi Phil, 

Is it possible to model both ability and speed using your mirt package? Input data are both item scores and minutes. 

Thank you!
Emily

messages.author: 2813deaeb3bf337c
messages.subject: Re: is it possible to model speed using mirt package
parts:
Hi Emily,

Your answer to this might provide Phil with more information for his answer.

Can you say how you want to model time and item scores? For example, there are diffusion models or van der Linden's approach? One simple approach I have been exploring for education tests is treating rapid responses as guesses, and this can improve ability estimates. In example #2 in the following I use mirt in conjunction with this.

https://www.degruyter.com/downloadpdf/j/edu.2019.1.issue-1/edu-2019-0004/edu-2019-0004.pdf

pm me if you want more information.

Dan

--
